'''Overseer of Cartel Operations, Tilnes Special Detachment''' was a title that was held by [[Ko Bas]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Caarite]] who commanded a secret [[Metatheran Cartel]] base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
